rules.cite: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: The rent increase limit applies to all residential rental units in Santa Ana.

key_values.name: cpi_multiplier
key_values.text: 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change

rules.quote: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.requirement: Landlords cannot increase rent by more than 3% of current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.
rules.title: Maximum Rent Increase Limit

rules.cite: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: The rent increase limit applies to all residential rental units in Santa Ana.

key_values.name: current_maximum_allowable_increase
key_values.text: 2.87 percent is the maximum allowable rent increase

rules.quote: 2.87 percent is the maximum allowable rent increase for the period of September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.
rules.requirement: The maximum allowable rent increase for the period from September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027 is 2.87 percent.
rules.title: Current Maximum Allowable Rent Increase for 2026-2027

rules.cite: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.coverage_text: The just cause eviction requirement applies to all residential rental units in Santa Ana.
rules.quote: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.
rules.requirement: Landlords must have a valid reason to evict a tenant, such as non-payment of rent, lease violation, or landlord move-in.
rules.title: Just Cause Eviction Requirement
